Name: PORTRAIT - Aideen - East Scarp
Author: Yakumaartes
Description:
Hello! I made this portrait for [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787?tab=description]East Scarp Mod's[/url] AIDEEEN, based on the art and mods of "[url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/78766618?tab=user+files]talkohlooeys[/url]"
To install it, simply extract the image and place it in the "Portraiture" folder.
This is if you already have a folder created there, if not, follow the instructions in the [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture [/url]mod and add the image as it asks!
